findings.title: Seccomp profile is not on the node
findings.cause: container api uses the Localhost seccomp profile /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/kd-hardened.json, which is not on node kd-faults-control-plane, so the container runtime cannot create the container; Deployment api has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: failed to create containerd container: cannot load seccomp profile "/var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/kd-hardened.json": open /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/kd-hardened.json: no such file or directory

evidence.what: the pod's and the container's seccompProfile

findings.fix: Put the profile on every node that may run the pod, under the kubelet's seccomp directory (the Security Profiles Operator or a DaemonSet can install it), keep the pod to the nodes that have it, or use seccompProfile type RuntimeDefault.
